paite: Aw, nam chihte aw, TOUPA phat unla; michihte aw, amah phat un.
heading: TOUPA Phatna
english: Praise Yahweh, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples!

paite: Azahngaihna i tung uah athupi in; TOUPA thutak tangtawn a om ding ahih ziak in. TOUPA phat un.
english: For his loving kindness is great toward us. Yahweh’s faithfulness endures forever. Praise Yah!
